intuition: A trie shares prefixes across candidate words, and board DFS explores only prefixes that can still form a word.

brute_force.approach: Run a full board search independently for every word.

optimal.approach: Build a trie, DFS from each cell, mark visited cells, and remove found words/empty trie branches for pruning.

edge_cases: A cell cannot be reused within one path.
Remove a found terminal to avoid duplicate output.
